gaps: No app-facing raw TCP or UDP connection API (NWConnection, NWParameters, NWEndpoint)
No service discovery (NWBrowser, mDNS or DNS-SD); the shell's UDP beacon is private
No QUIC, WebSocket or custom protocol framer
No path monitor for app reachability or interface changes (NWPathMonitor)
No TLS handshake options, client identities or TLS metadata for apps
